title: Bubble construction and editable form
slide_intent: Expose how a visual effect is built so a designer can understand which parts remain adjustable.
strategic_value: An editable bubble construction can help O2 carry a consistent ingredient into varied digital compositions.
demonstration: A circular path with control points becomes a shaded bubble; the clip also exposes selection bounds and a cursor against a blue gradient.
practical_value: Separate the underlying outline from its shading when adapting the bubble’s form.

content_islands.name: Gradient canvas
content_islands.spec: Use a dark-to-light blue field behind the construction.

content_islands.name: Outline and finish
content_islands.spec: Center a circular path with nodes, then show its shaded translucent version and selection bounds.

reference_purposes.Intent: The surrounding section identifies flexibility and interaction as the reasons for redesigning the bubble.
reference_purposes.Application: The construction demonstration connects a controllable path to the finished shaded bubble.
reference_purposes.Expression: The finished form uses translucent blue shading with a bright irregular rim.
